$comment: Coordinator operations (POST /api/ops/<name>), called by the app and, as MCP tools, by agents. operations lists every registered operation: read (a read snapshot), long (no surrounding transaction), errors (status codes the handler itself returns; every operation can also return 401 signed out, 403 role or grant, and 500). Each operation <name> has $defs <Name>Request and <Name>Reply. A failed call answers OpError. planned lists operations specified contract first and not built yet (docs/designs/fleet-definition-editors.md); building one moves it to operations. go/coordinator checks at test time that operations equals its registry.

Actor.$comment: person: the person (kind person); executionId: the agent execution (kind agent); system: reconcile. directedBy is set for person and agent.

AgentDefinition.$comment: The agent profile (contracts/profile.schema.json); go/contract.ParseProfile is its validator.

AgentListFacts.$comment: harness defaults as at session start; roles: the project roles (project.json roles) that name this profile.

AgentTestRequest.$comment: draft true uses the caller's draft; false the head revision.

ArtifactListReply.$comment: nextBefore: only with limit; null on the last page.

Block.$comment: One thread entry (docs/designs/fleet-conversations.md), told apart by kind. key is its position seq:part. Fleet's own projection: closed.

BoundaryBlock.$comment: Start of an execution in the thread.

CatalogueDefinition.$comment: The whole config/catalogue.json as it is today (one capability).

CatalogueReply.$comment: The definition editors change methods to CatalogueMethodView items (docs/designs/fleet-definition-editors.md).

Change.$comment: One committed change (the change table), as GET /api/stream and changes_since deliver it.

ChangeKind.$comment: The kinds the change triggers write (fleet_change and fleet_artifact_change in go/coordinator/schema.sql); a go test checks the triggers against this list.

ChangesSinceReply.$comment: resync: the cursor fell out of retention, reload everything. held: a writer still holds older changes; read again.

ChangesSinceRequest.$comment: No cursor: the head, with no changes. limit is clamped to 1..1000 (default 500).

DefinitionConflict.$comment: Body of a 409 from definition_save and definition_create.

DefinitionContent.$comment: Exactly one property, matching the kind.

DefinitionExportRequest.$comment: No keys: every definition in state ahead or store-only. repository-changed and repository-deleted are never exported (named keys in those states: 409 repository-changed) until a save resolves them, so an export cannot revert a release.

DefinitionMirrorResetRequest.$comment: confirm must be the repository name; owner only. Rebuilds the mirror branch from store history and force-pushes.

DefinitionRef.$comment: With draft true, revision is the base revision (0 for a new definition) and contentSha is the draft's.

DiffFile.$comment: state added, removed, unchanged or modified; textChange only for small html and css files.

DiffSide.$comment: Exactly one of revision, draft (the caller's draft) or repository (the shipped file).

EffectiveLayer.$comment: source is a path or a URL; revision is the store revision, the specq commit or the project file sha; fields lists the setting paths this layer decides.

ExecutionDifferencesRequest.$comment: previous: the earlier execution of the same session.

items.$comment: A stored host event (native data stays raw).

ExecutionRow.$comment: One execution row (executionCols in go/coordinator/tasks.go); times are RFC 3339.

resume.$comment: session_resume's reply for the execution's session.

ExecutionStatusReply.$comment: next: the suggested operation (message, session_fork, execution_status or wait_or_steer). stop only after a stop request.

ExecutionStopReply.$comment: The stop command and the stop outcome.

ExecutionsListRequest.$comment: Filters; problem true keeps executions with a problem.

FieldChange.$comment: fromText and toText are the canonical JSON text of the old and new values; the editor uses path to place the attention tick.

LabExperimentPromoteRequest.$comment: Replaces lab_promote's request when lab_experiment_promote is built.

ListFilter.$comment: The list filter of packages/view-url toPageParams; a null projectId is work outside projects.

ListMembershipRequest.$comment: At most 1000 ids and one or two lists.

ListRow.$comment: A task or session row of a list page; sortKey positions it (strings and numbers).

MeReply.$comment: email, name and grantsVersion are null without a person (agent-only stand).

MembershipAnswer.$comment: rows: the ids that are members of the list now.

MirrorState.$comment: Stage 2 only; the mirror and definition_mirror_reset fields and operation are added with it.

OpError.$comment: Body of every failed operation (writeError in go/coordinator/main.go).

PipelineRunCreateRequest.$comment: Body of POST /api/pipelines/{id}/runs (pipelineRunCreate) as an operation pipeline_run_create; pipelineId was the URL segment. draft true runs the caller's draft. The request signature includes draft and the content sha.

PipelineStep.$comment: Step kinds are the registry's (D20); validatePipeline stays the full check.

Problem.$comment: Validation finding; path is a JSON pointer into the content. A draft is stored even when invalid; save refuses it.

QuestionBlock.$comment: options: the stored options as they are (a list of labels for agent questions).

ResultBlock.$comment: The stored artifacts of an ended execution.

SessionCreateReply.$comment: The new session row, plus sessionId.

SessionsListReply.$comment: nextAfter: null on the last page, else the sort key to pass as after.

SessionsListRequest.$comment: after: the nextAfter of the previous page.

StopOutcome.$comment: outcome proven (detail stopped or already_finished) or unknown (detail unconfirmed, with the stop command when one exists).

StreamCursor.$comment: Body of the GET /api/stream events ready (the cursor the stream starts after) and resync (reload everything, then continue after cursor).

TextBlock.$comment: role agent or operator; by: the sender of an operator message; stream open or cut-off while a delta is the newest text; harness, model and effort mark agent text.

ThreadBlocksReply.$comment: removed: block keys that no longer exist.

ThreadBlocksRequest.$comment: rows: changed records; the reply has their current blocks.

ThreadEntriesReply.$comment: total: only with around. feedCursor: the change cursor of this read, to catch up from.

ThreadKey.$comment: Exactly one of task or session.

ToolBlock.$comment: input and output are the harness's own values; times in ms.

TransportAuthorizeRequest.$comment: Exactly these four keys (the request signature is their hash).

TransportInspectReply.$comment: Retained transport of one execution; never reruns native work.

VariantVsBaseline.$comment: Added to lab_experiment_get: one per non-baseline variant, over examples where both have a final score.

SubscriptionLimitsRefreshRequest.$comment: fleet-people-access.md section 8 "Read without a run": one subscription, or every one the caller holds (the owner: all)
